About.title: About
About.intro: Matmoora is an independent Sudanese initiative building a public, free-to-use record of human rights violations in Sudan — investigations, testimonies, and evidence held together for accountability, memory, and analysis.
About.whoBody: An independent Sudanese initiative documenting human rights violations in Sudan and turning that documentation into a public reference for legal accountability, collective memory, and analysis. We are researchers, journalists, artists and community members working together.
About.whatBody: We produce long-form investigations grounded in field interviews and open-source analysis, and translate them into stories, testimonies, and visual and audio material that reach audiences in their own language. Every investigation is an entry point into the full body of evidence around it.
About.howBody: We follow a dual methodology combining closed sources — field interviews with survivors, witnesses, and practitioners — with open-source analysis of images, videos, documents, and satellite imagery. Every claim is cross-verified against standard protocols such as the Berkeley Protocol on Digital Open Source Investigations.
